inputs.source: Original TF2 index00, original image/seed42/conditioning SHA bound by original DQ/UB1 controls
inputs.exposure: Development-exposed; no validation or fresh final claim
inputs.trajectory: Original DQ post restored only between complete native steps; same fixed states as original TF2 UB1. Not free student rollout.

execution_plan.order: One UB1 full native generation/control capture; separate process verifies exact head replay before autograd, then exactly one fixed update

update.objective: Mean squared full final flow error against original independent DQ flow at matched full-step input
update.optimizer: One global normalized negative gradient step; all four existing tensors updated; FP32 masters cast BF16 at original GEMMs

operator: Original post-Q1 input -> existing BF16 R256 -> BF16 addition to unchanged main -> separate BF16 gate multiply and residual add -> original parameter-free torch layernorm eps1e-6 -> separate BF16 head scale multiply and shift add -> original BF16 head addmm -> original unpatchify/FP32 flow
gradient: Autograd through BF16 casts, dense R256 and actual head. Freeze Q1/main and earlier layers; no gradient through HiF4 quantizer or secant surrogate. Native head addmm out= removed only after zero-update byte controls. BF16 rounding itself uses PyTorch cast derivative; one actual rounded update evaluated.
controls: Complete reconstructed main+R256 equals original FFN Y
stop: Any control failure stops before gradient; preserve failed report. Nonfinite/disconnected gradients or no deployed BF16 change stops. Exactly one step regardless loss; no extra LR/epsilon/position/source/step search. Report improvement or regression without candidate acceptance. Any subsequent training/comparison requires its own frozen protocol.
cost: One full4step native generation and one fullM final-head backward plus one updated forward. Same deployed R256 rank/width and frozen main support; additional inference parameters0. Saved complete tensors <3GiB in HF cache; preserve80GiB free reserve. Gradient process separated from full model residency. Not full160 timing or >=1.5x acceptance.
final_contract: Unchanged50%mainMAC, completeFFN>=1.5x including auxiliaries, fresh frozen source cohort each official quality axis<=2%drop. No final cohort selected.
